blurb: Broadway Bound Dance Centre offers dance classes for children and adults with various styles including ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop, acro, lyrical, and musical theater. Classes are organized by age groups and skill levels, with options for performance in recitals and company participation. Enrollment is term-based, following the local school calendar, with registration available online, by mail, or in person.
extraNote: Registrations must include registration fee to hold space · Open enrollment closes November 1st for School Year Term · Participation in recital is optional · Costumes must be purchased for recital; prices vary · School Year Term mid-August to May; Summer Term late May/early June onward
